captures.name: legacy-540p-tilted
captures.note: older phone: soft, noisy, barrel distortion, glare gradient

captures.name: soft-480p-blur1.9
captures.note: out of focus 480p; a field lane must not be reported unless correct

captures.name: small-480p
captures.note: low-end preview resolution and soft focus

captures.name: overexposed-540p
captures.note: auto-exposure blows the petals out three-fold

captures.name: veiled-720p
captures.note: older phone in a bright room: reflections lift the black level by half the lit level

captures.name: shadow-band-540p
captures.note: a band across the middle of the code in shadow (40 % light); finder levels cannot describe it, the local read does

captures.name: hidden-corner-540p
captures.note: a thumb covers the bottom-left blossom; the fourth corner is inferred from the other three

captures.name: cut-corner-720p
captures.note: held too close: one corner of the code is outside the frame and is inferred

captures.name: barrel-480p
captures.note: a cheap wide lens: strong barrel distortion moves the outer petals off a plain pose; the decoder finds the distortion

tracks.name: steady-hand-540p
tracks.note: the next analysed frame after a small hand movement; tracking reuses the pose

tracks.name: thumb-arrives-540p
tracks.note: a thumb covers the top-right blossom between two frames; tracking infers it

merges.name: noisy-480p
merges.note: a soft 480p camera in very dim light: sensor noise costs every capture its field lanes; the four averaged read them

mixed_merges.name: mixed-frames-480p
mixed_merges.note: the rings show frame 23 and the petal field frame 24 (a capture the frame change tore): the merge reads the field lanes of frame 24, which a session must not offer for frame 23
